evals: (() => { const h = [...document.querySelectorAll('h2,h3,h4,p,div,span')].find(e => e.textContent.trim() === 'Building something'); const card = h.closest('div[class*=rounded], section, article') || h.parentElement; card.scrollIntoView({block: 'center'}); window.scrollBy(0, 40); return 1; })()

boxes.heading: [...document.querySelectorAll('h2,h3,h4,p,div,span')].find(e => e.textContent.trim() === 'Building something')
boxes.card: (() => { const h = [...document.querySelectorAll('h2,h3,h4,p,div,span')].find(e => e.textContent.trim() === 'Building something'); let c = h; for (let i = 0; i < 6 && c; i++) { c = c.parentElement; if (c && c.textContent.includes('Start free') && c.textContent.includes('Invite your own tradies')) return c; } return h.parentElement; })()
boxes.tenders: [...document.querySelectorAll('li,p,span,div')].find(e => e.children.length <= 2 && e.textContent.trim().startsWith('Post tenders and take bids'))
boxes.start: (() => { const h = [...document.querySelectorAll('h2,h3,h4,p,div,span')].find(e => e.textContent.trim() === 'Building something'); let c = h; for (let i = 0; i < 6 && c; i++) { c = c.parentElement; if (c && c.textContent.includes('Invite your own tradies')) break; } return [...c.querySelectorAll('a,button')].find(e => e.textContent.trim() === 'Start free'); })()
